title: Slice identity: Y(flatD(dω(t + ·))) = Σ_a (−1)^a Y(D_{g_a}(flatF a ∘ ω)(t + ·)) + (−1)^{j+1} X(flat(ω(t + ·)))
statement:
Let P, j, m, n' ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_0, …, g_j) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) be any family of vectors, h : n' = (j + 1) + m, h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1), h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1). Let flatD : Λ^{n'+1} → Λ^{m+1}, flat : Λ^{n'} → Λ^m and flatF a : Λ^{n'} → Λ^{m+1} (a ∈ Fin (j + 1)) be continuous linear maps with flatD α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁), flat α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h) and flatF a α v = α(Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂). Let Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ) with Y.boundary = X, let ω be a test n'-form (ω : TestFormOn univ n', with underlying form ω̂) and t ∈ ℝ^P. Then
currentEval Y (y ↦ flatD(dω̂(t + y))) = Σ_{a ∈ Fin (j+1)} (−1)^a · currentEval Y (y ↦ D[z ↦ flatF a(ω̂(z))](t + y)[g_a]) + (−1)^{j+1} · currentEval X (y ↦ flat(ω̂(t + y))),
where D = fderiv ℝ and d = exteriorDerivative.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) (h : n' = (j + 1) + m) (h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1)) (h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (flatD : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) m) (flatF : Fin (j + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (t : Euclid P), Y.boundary = X → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1)) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatD α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁)) → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → (∀ (a : Fin (j + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatF a α v = α (Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂)) → currentEval Y (fun y => flatD (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y))) = ∑ a : Fin (j + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a : ℕ) * currentEval Y (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => flatF a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') z)) (t + y) (g a)) + (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * currentEval X (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y)))
